usage: xo check [--json] [--no-gc] [--fix] [--wip] <dirs...>

Resolve names and type check the modules under each directory (every
directory holding .xo files is a module; imports are resolved through
xo.mod and the embedded std). --json prints {"modules": [...],
"diagnostics": [...]} on stdout. --no-gc also runs the check of native
builds (XO1201 for what they cannot build yet, or ever; decision 0083).
--fix first applies every unambiguous machine fix (as xo fix) and
reformats the changed files, then reports what remains (decision 0096).
--wip reports the errors of code still being written, an unused binding
or import (XO0110) and an unused computed value (XO0209), as warnings,
so a check passes mid edit; a normal check and every build keep them
errors (decision 0293).
Exit status is 1 when any error is reported (warnings such as holes do
not count), 2 on usage errors.

A directory covers the directories below it, so DIR/... is DIR (decision
0210); a DIR/... with no .xo file at or below DIR is an error.
